name: setActiveSessionTitle
description: Report the active session's display title so the host can update the kNexus window's native title (taskbar / alt-tab / a11y). The host sanitizes the title and composes the final "{title} - {product name}" string itself (CustomBrowserView::GetWindowTitle); an empty string clears back to the bare product name. Fire-and-forget: succeeds even when no kNexus window exists (e.g. mid-close).

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: The active session's resolved display title (customTitle > ai title > derived first prompt), without any product-name suffix. Empty string clears the title.
